name: Gondwana Plateau
description: A desolate, ancient, and weightless dimension dominated by a colossal, looming sentient planet in the sky.
notes: A reality-fractured plateau representing the deep-time biological memory of the ancient supercontinent Gondwana. Trees, rivers, and cliffs float weightlessly. It houses ancient volcanic black lingams and half-buried stone tablets with archaic glyphs, accessible from the mortal realm only through space-time rifts and cosmic wormholes.
sources: Digha Jani and the Cosmic Secrets of Jambhudweepa
The Predatory Sentience of Asura Planets
